components.name: Completion button
components.css: .ds-done{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;height:44px;min-width:64px;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--color-indigo-700, #236E48);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05);transition:background-color .15s;}.ds-done:hover{background:var(--color-indigo-800, #1A5234);}.ds-done:focus-visible{outline:auto;}

components.name: Login button
components.description: Visible mobile sign-in action with inline SVG icon.
components.html: <button class="ds-login"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-4M10 17l5-5-5-5M15 12H3"/></svg>登入</button>
components.css: .ds-login{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:var(--color-indigo-700, #236E48);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05);transition:background-color .15s;}.ds-login:hover{background:var(--color-indigo-800, #1A5234);}.ds-login:focus-visible{outline:auto;}.ds-login:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;}

components.name: Reference action
components.description: Quiet bordered action within reference editors.
components.css: .ds-reference{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;min-height:48px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e7eb);border-radius:10px;background:var(--color-surface-muted, #f9fafb);color:var(--color-text-muted, #4b5563);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;transition:border-color .15s;}.ds-reference:hover{border-color:var(--color-indigo-200, #B6E3CA);}.ds-reference:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-indigo-500, #3DAA78);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Mobile field
components.description: Explicit label and readable text-entry value.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">歌名<input class="ds-field" placeholder="輸入歌名" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;display:grid;gap:8px;color:var(--color-text-muted, #4b5563);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;}.ds-field{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;height:48px;min-width:0;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e7eb);border-radius:10px;background:var(--color-surface-muted, #f9fafb);color:var(--color-text, #111827);font-size:16px;font-weight:500;}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--color-text-muted, #4b5563);opacity:1;}.ds-field:focus{border-color:var(--color-indigo-500, #3DAA78);}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-indigo-500, #3DAA78);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Song information tabs
components.description: Equal-width direct destinations with selected underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;display:flex;gap:20px;background:var(--color-surface, #ffffff);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e7eb);}.ds-tabs button{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;flex:1;min-height:48px;padding:0 0 12px;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--color-text-muted, #4b5563);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--color-indigo-700, #236E48);border-bottom-color:var(--color-indigo-600, #2E8C5E);}.ds-tabs button:hover{color:var(--color-indigo-600, #2E8C5E);}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-indigo-500, #3DAA78);outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tabs button{transition:none;}}:host-context(.dark) .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"]{color:var(--color-indigo-400, #5EBD8F);}

components.name: Workspace badge
components.css: .ds-badge{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;display:inline-block;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--color-indigo-50, #F0FAF5);color:var(--color-indigo-700, #236E48);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--color-indigo-200, #B6E3CA);}:host-context(.dark) .ds-badge{background:var(--color-indigo-950, #0D1F17);color:var(--color-indigo-200, #B6E3CA);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--color-indigo-800, #1A5234);}

components.name: Editing sheet
components.description: Continuous surface with rounded modal boundary.
components.css: .ds-sheet{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;background:var(--color-surface, #ffffff);color:var(--color-text, #111827);border:1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e7eb);border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;box-shadow:0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / .25);overflow:hidden;}.ds-sheet-handle{height:4px;width:36px;margin:10px auto 0;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--color-border, #e5e7eb);}.ds-sheet-title{margin:0;padding:12px 20px 16px;font-size:18px;line-height:28px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border, #e5e7eb);}

components.name: Groove switch
components.description: Full-field checkbox with distinct track states and a white thumb in either theme.
components.css: .ds-switch-field{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;height:48px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid var(--color-border,#e5e7eb);border-radius:10px;background:var(--color-surface-muted,#f9fafb);color:var(--color-text,#111827);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;}.ds-switch-input{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;z-index:1;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;}.ds-switch-track{position:relative;flex-shrink:0;width:40px;height:24px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--color-border-strong,#d1d5db);transition:background-color .15s;}.ds-switch-thumb{position:absolute;left:2px;top:2px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--color-white,#fff);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05);transition:transform .15s;}.ds-switch-input:checked+.ds-switch-track{background:var(--color-indigo-700,#236E48);}.ds-switch-input:checked+.ds-switch-track .ds-switch-thumb{transform:translateX(16px);}.ds-switch-input:focus-visible+.ds-switch-track{outline:2px solid var(--color-indigo-300,#8AD0AC);outline-offset:2px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-switch-track,.ds-switch-thumb{transition:none;}}

components.name: Active notation mode key
components.description: Active 48px notation mode option; musical glyph sizes remain local to their functions.
components.html: <button class="ds-note-active" aria-pressed="true" aria-label="固定調簡譜輸入">固定調</button>
components.css: .ds-note-active{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;height:48px;min-width:0;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid var(--color-indigo-500,#3DAA78);border-radius:11px;background:var(--color-indigo-700,#236E48);color:var(--color-white,#fff);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;transition:transform 75ms,background-color 75ms;}.ds-note-active:hover{background:var(--color-indigo-700,#236E48);}.ds-note-active:active{transform:translateY(1px) scale(.98);}.ds-note-active:focus-visible{outline:auto;}.ds-note-active:disabled{opacity:.4;}

components.name: Voice selector
components.description: In-place horizontal voice choices with direct rename and add controls.
components.css: .ds-voice-selector{font-family:Inter, PingFang TC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans TC, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 10px;background:var(--color-surface,#fff);color:var(--color-text,#111827);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border,#e5e7eb);}.ds-voice-choices{display:flex;flex:1;min-width:0;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;}.ds-voice-choice{font-family:inherit;height:44px;max-width:160px;flex-shrink:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:0 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;background:transparent;color:var(--color-text-muted,#4b5563);}.ds-voice-choice:hover,.ds-voice-action:hover{background:var(--color-surface-muted,#f9fafb);}.ds-voice-choice[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--color-indigo-100,#DAF1E5);color:var(--color-indigo-800,#1A5234);}.ds-voice-action{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:44px;height:44px;flex-shrink:0;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--color-text-muted,#4b5563);}.ds-voice-choice:focus-visible,.ds-voice-action:focus-visible{outline:auto;}.ds-voice-action:disabled{opacity:.4;}:host-context(.dark) .ds-voice-choice[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--color-indigo-950,#0D1F17);color:var(--color-indigo-200,#B6E3CA);}

narrative.overview:
ChordMaster retains its existing green musical workspace: a quiet, practical interface around charts, musical settings and editing. Inter and Traditional Chinese sans-serif fallbacks carry the UI; musical notation and printable charts keep their own specialist typography. This document records the implemented system rather than establishing a new identity.

Mobile reading and full editing have equal importance. Controls remain legible and reachable while overlays preserve the underlying chart position. Semantic surfaces support light and dark themes; a restrained green accent identifies actions and selection. Theme choice can be light, dark or system-following, with interface and native form-control color schemes kept in sync. Charts keep chords and their corresponding lower notation together as one readable musical unit.
keyCharacteristics: Existing green identity with semantic light/dark surfaces.
Compact desktop tools and larger mobile editing controls.
Clear labels, rounded fields and restrained borders.
Independent overlay scrolling with persistent chart position.

rules.name: The Semantic Surface Rule
rules.body: Use surface, border and text roles for theme-aware UI; the dark theme changes their values rather than the meaning of the roles.

rules.name: The Inherited Green Rule
rules.body: Existing indigo-named utilities resolve to the ChordMaster green scale. Preserve that mapping when extending the app.

rules.name: The Chart Position Rule
rules.body: Opening and scrolling a mobile editor preserves the background chart position; closing restores access to that same position.

rules.name: The Paper and UI Rule
rules.body: Theme changes affect interface chrome while printable chart paper and ink retain their established palette.

dos: Do use the semantic surface, border and text roles together in light and dark UI.
Do preserve the existing UI font and the green mapping behind indigo utilities.
Do use 44–48px primary mobile touch controls; padded segmented rails contain 40px options.
Do keep modal content independently scrollable, retain visible completion controls and respect safe-area insets.
Do retain visible focus, keyboard navigation and meaningful labels.
Do preserve native form-control color schemes alongside the root theme and respect explicit theme choices.
Do keep notation key height floors and allow the center of a short phone dock to scroll.
Do preserve dedicated switch thumb and track colors when changing theme compatibility rules.
Do keep voice selection and per-bar naming inside the same notation workflow, with chart selection feedback.
Do distinguish shared bar text from the name and notation of an individual voice.
Do keep timed lower notation close to its chord/pass stack and reserve real space for additional voices.
Do preserve untimed and unmetered rendering when applying compact chart geometry.
Do render the same saved setlist arrangement in selected previews, unselected previews and export.
donts: Don't promote the mobile song editor's three-tab composition into a requirement for every screen.
Don't substitute raw white and gray styling for theme-aware roles in new mobile editing surfaces.
Don't use muted or faint text roles interchangeably: labels and placeholder text in the mobile editor use the muted role.
Don't change chart or notation typography to match UI controls; export keeps its printable light appearance.
Don't let generic dark compatibility override dedicated component variants or printable chart content.
Don't reserve empty filler below notation keys; use content-sized panels with bounded center scrolling.
Don't distribute spare A4 height inside timed notation-bearing rows or inflate ordinary single-melody pagination.
